name: Solve an incident and retain private progress
description: Verify authenticated command practice saves durable private progress.
steps: When signed out, verify sign-in screen hides progress. Sign in using an available AppDeploy test account and open The restart loop.
Submit echo hello and verify no supported pattern matched.
Submit these three commands together: kubectl logs ledger-api-7c9 --previous\nkubectl set env deployment/ledger-api DB_HOST=db.copper-lab.svc\nkubectl rollout status deployment/ledger-api
Verify all three objectives pass and score is 100. Refresh and reopen the exercise. Verify history, attempts and completed status persist. Sign out.
expected: All objectives complete and saved results survive refresh. Sign-out hides private progress.

name: Progressive hints, solution and reset on mobile
description: Verify assistance and reset preserve coherent mobile progress.
steps: Sign in and open Running is not ready. Reveal all three hints sequentially. Verify distinct hints and disabled further hint button.
Show solution and verify explanation and example commands. Copy all displayed example commands into the command field and submit. Verify all objectives pass and score is capped at 40.
Refresh and reopen. Verify hints, solution, and completion persist.
Choose Reset this exercise then Keep progress. Verify progress remains. Choose reset again and Confirm reset. Refresh and reopen.
expected: Confirmed reset clears attempts, hints, solution reveal, score and completion. Mobile controls fit the viewport.

name: Full curriculum and topic progress
description: Verify all curriculum examples score correctly and feed progress views.
steps: Sign in. Verify 10 exercise cards with filters cleared. Search Storage and verify Storage at the limit. Clear search. Select Monitoring and verify two exercises. Return to All exercises.

For each of these exercises, open it, Show solution, copy all displayed example commands into the command field and submit: Permission denied, Storage at the limit, A green build, a broken release, GitOps keeps reverting the fix, The noisy pager, Averages hide the slow requests, A script that hides failures, Recover before investigating deeper.
Verify every example completes every objective. Verify each exercise includes scenario, symptoms, evidence, challenge, three hints available, explanation and completion check.
Return to library, enable Hide completed exercises and verify completed cards disappear. Disable the filter.
Open My progress. Verify completed count and attempts reflect results. Verify assisted topics show Needs practice. Open an exercise from the results list.
expected: All ten exercises exist, all eight submitted solution examples pass, and search, filters, progress and weak topics reflect saved data.

name: User isolation across account switching
description: Verify two signed-in users never share answers or progress.
steps: Actor A signs in and opens The restart loop. Submit echo actor-a-private-marker.
Actor A signs out and Actor B signs in with a different AppDeploy test account. Open The restart loop and verify A’s marker is absent and B has independent progress.
Actor B signs out. Actor A signs back in and reopens The restart loop.
expected: Only Actor A sees actor-a-private-marker and A’s saved progress.

name: Validation and save error recovery
description: Verify invalid input and failed saves display actionable errors.
steps: Sign in and open The restart loop. Note attempt count. Leave command empty and Submit commands. Verify enter-command validation and unchanged attempts.
Enter oc logs ledger-api-7c9 --previous and submit. Verify visible error says progress was not confirmed.
Use Retry loading saved progress. Verify saved attempt count remains unchanged.
expected: Empty input is blocked, failed save is visible, and saved state reloads without falsely claiming success.
